# Overview

On 10/02 I did our final assessment of the Effort E (fresh water and thermal hardening) seed at Goose Point and closed out this project!      

## Final assessment 

I did the following today to assess and close out the Effort E Goose Point seed experiment: 

- Goose Point collected our cages and brought them to the dock. 1 bag was missing (no. 342; FW treated) and 1 was empty (no. 343; Temp treated). There were 12 in good shape. We had n=5 of FW control, n=2 FW treated, n=3 Temp control, and n=2 Temp treated cages.  
- Removed oysters from each cage and counted mortalities
- Arranged oysters for a photograph to capture number of live animals and for growth analysis
- Tag and scale bar included in each photo
- Subsampled oysters from each bag to total n=~30 oysters per treatment group (4 treatment groups total) into red mesh bags with their own tag labels for survival assays in the lab (see below)
- Bags and equipment were cleaned 
- Four temperature loggers were downloaded that were brought in on the cages. 
- I recorded data and uploaded size image photos.  
- I will transport oysters to UW on Sunday. 
- I took manual measurements of a subset of oysters for length, width, and depth. 

All data is in our [oyster hardening seed GitHub repo](https://github.com/RobertsLab/project-gigas-conditioning/).
